purpose: Teach: 結び付け/可変/一望/財務諸表/苦心/降格/行きつけ/委嘱

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業時、社員の働きを成果に結び付けて評価された
lines.en: Father — at the founding, he linked his staff's work directly to measurable results in how he evaluated them.
lines.style: Gentle, measured pace. A soft opening on the name, then steady — the voice of someone recalling with clear-eyed warmth. No rush. Each phrase lands with quiet weight.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは可変的な経営判断もされた
lines.en: Yes. He made flexible business decisions too, adapting when circumstances demanded it.
lines.style: Warm acknowledgment. A nod in the voice — matching the elder's rhythm but grounding it in specificity. Steady eye contact. The respect of a son who understood his father's method.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、屋上から街を一望されて構想を練られた
lines.en: Father — he'd stand on the rooftop overlooking the whole city to think through his plans.
lines.style: Softly wistful, almost distant. A pause before the image lands. Slow, deliberate pacing — the voice of someone watching the memory play out. Slight warmth at the edges.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは財務諸表を毎週確認された
lines.en: Yes. He reviewed the financial statements every single week without fail.
lines.style: Patient, grounded. Speaking of discipline with the steady tone of someone who inherited its value. No sentimentality — just the facts of a man's character, clearly stated.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、苦心して新事業を立ち上げられた
lines.en: Father — he went through great hardship launching new ventures, but he persisted.
lines.style: Quieter, more contemplative. A slight tremor of empathy for the struggle beneath the achievement. The pace slows — honoring both the effort and the outcome. Trailing warmth.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは降格処分の判断にも公平でらした
lines.en: Yes. And when he had to demote someone, he did it with complete fairness — no favoritism.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. The words carry weight because they describe something difficult done right. Steady delivery, no apology in the tone. A son speaking the hard truth his father embodied.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、行きつけのお店でお取引先と懇談された
lines.en: Father — at his favorite restaurant, he'd have deep conversations with business partners over meals.
lines.style: Warm, gently nostalgic. The voice settles into the memory like a comfortable chair. Slight affection in the pacing. Speaking of both the man and the moment.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは外部の有識者に研究を委嘱された
lines.en: Yes. He also entrusted important research projects to trusted outside experts — he knew when to lean on others' knowledge.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly slower. The closing words of a son summing up his father's wisdom with care and finality. Gentle landing — not rushed, but complete. A quiet close that honors the whole.
